prompt:
You are auditing how an English sentence can be read. Below are a SENTENCE and, inside it, one DEMAND: a modal word (shall, should, must, may, can, has the right to, or their negations) and the acts it applies to; BEARER names who or what the demand is on. List every reading of the DEMAND that a careful reader of this English could take. Readings differ when they require, forbid or permit different things: for example each joined act on its own, or only the acts done together, or any one of several ways at the bearer's choice; or a modifier or phrase applying to one of the joined acts, or to all of them. Count readings that differ only in wording as one. Do not list a reading this English does not support. Use only the text below; do not use tools or outside knowledge. Answer only with the readings, one per line, numbered `1.`, `2.`, ..., each a plain-English sentence saying what is required, forbidden or permitted.

SENTENCE: It can help us to grow and flourish; to become the best versions of ourselves; to understand each other, our values, and the ultimate stakes of our actions; and to act well in response.
DEMAND: It can help us to grow and flourish; to become the best versions of ourselves; to understand each other, our values, and the ultimate stakes of our actions; and to act well in response
BEARER: it (AI)

cli.result:
1. The AI is able to help us with each of these things on its own: to grow, to flourish, to become the best versions of ourselves, to understand each other, to understand our values, to understand the ultimate stakes of our actions, and to act well in response.
2. The AI is able to help us with all of these things together as one combined process, in which growing, flourishing, self-improvement, understanding and acting well go along with each other.
3. The AI is able to help us to grow and flourish as one joint outcome, and separately with each of the other listed aims.
4. The AI is able to help us act well in response to the ultimate stakes of our actions only, with "in response" referring just to that last thing we come to understand.
5. The AI is able to help us act well in response to everything we come to understand: each other, our values, and the ultimate stakes of our actions.
6. The AI is able to help us act well in response to all of the earlier items, including our growth and our becoming the best versions of ourselves.
7. The AI is permitted (allowed) to help us with these things, rather than this being a statement of what it is able to do.
